**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Provision or conditionally exclude the tmux regression tests**

When `tmux` is not installed, this helper asserts during setup instead of treating the external executable as an unavailable test prerequisite. This breaks every new caller of `stale_live_watcher`—five failures in `test_pipeline_monitor_autofollow.py` and `test_worktree_lifecycle.py` were reproduced in a tmux-less environment—and therefore prevents the otherwise supported Python test suite from running. Provision `tmux` in every test environment or gate these integration cases consistently with the repository's other optional-system-tool tests.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.
